devdoc.details: The registry stores opaque keys and holds no rule about how they are derived, how many belong to an      intent, or what they mean.The immutable predecessor keeps every pre-cutover nullifier and binding authoritative. New writes are      local; a binding can never be replaced.CUTOVER INVARIANT: before this registry accepts its first live write, every retired verifier must      permanently lose write permission on the predecessor and payment methods must never be routed      back to it. The predecessor cannot observe V3 writes, so rollback would otherwise reopen replay.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

devdoc.title: NullifierRegistryV3

intentHashByNullifier(bytes32).notice: Intent a nullifier is bound to; zero if unused or consumed before the predecessor recorded intents.

userdoc.notice: Enforces payment replay protection while binding every nullifier to the intent it fulfilled. A payment         can consume several nullifiers, so one intent can hold many.
